name: ralph-codex
description: Skills and prompts for the Ralph autonomous Codex CLI task loop.

interface.shortDescription: Run PRD stories through a long-running Codex CLI loop
interface.longDescription: Ralph Codex converts PRDs into small JSON stories and runs fresh Codex CLI iterations until every story is complete, preserving memory through git history, progress.txt, prd.json, and AGENTS.md.
defaultPrompt: Create a PRD for this feature
Convert this PRD to Ralph prd.json
